name: Retrospective (Agile)
description: Sprint retrospective template for continuous improvement.
description_it: Retrospettiva di sprint per il miglioramento continuo.

sections.title: Sprint
sections.instruction: Sprint name/number and date range only if stated, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Attendance
sections.instruction: Names of the participants as they appear in the transcript

sections.title: Start Doing
sections.instruction: Actions or experiments to start next sprint

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Concrete experiments with owners, due date and success metric; any field not stated is 'Not stated'

sections.title: Notes & Votes
sections.instruction: Summary of the discussion and top-voted items if votes were taken
